items.title: Connecticut judge rules CFTC cannot override court reading of federal law in Kalshi case
items.content_text: - **Connecticut judge rules CFTC cannot override court reading of federal law in Kalshi case** — U.S. District Judge Vernon Oliver ruled the CFTC lacks authority to override the court interpretation of federal law in the Connecticut prediction markets case, finding its August 11 market emergency order did not change his earlier analysis. The ruling follows his denial of Kalshi request for a preliminary injunction, after he found its sports-event contracts do not qualify as swaps under the Commodity Exchange Act. ([GambleRss](https://gamblerss.com/connecticut-judge-says-cftc-cannot-override-court-s-reading-of-federal-law-in-prediction-markets-case-67760))

items.title: Wisconsin judge denies CFTC bid to block state prediction market enforcement
items.content_text: - **Wisconsin judge denies CFTC bid to block state prediction market enforcement** — U.S. District Judge William Griesbach ruled the CFTC did not show irreparable harm or a likelihood of success in its suit against Wisconsin officials, so the state can keep pursuing its cases against platforms including Coinbase, Crypto.com, Kalshi and Polymarket. The CFTC had argued Wisconsin was criminalizing federally regulated markets beyond its powers. ([SBC Americas](https://sbcamericas.com/2026/07/29/wisconsin-judge-denies-cftc-injunction/))

items.title: Kalshi and Polymarket chief executives back 5(c) Capital 35 million dollar prediction markets fund
items.content_text: - **Kalshi and Polymarket chief executives back 5(c) Capital 35 million dollar prediction markets fund** — Kalshi chief executive Tarek Mansour and Polymarket chief executive Shayne Coplan are among the backers of a new 35 million dollar fund from 5(c) Capital, the first venture fund focused on prediction market startups. items.title: Researchers question parts of Kalshi and Polymarket perpetual futures volume as platforms deny wash trading
items.content_text: - **Researchers question parts of Kalshi and Polymarket perpetual futures volume as platforms deny wash trading** — A working paper by Ulm University finance professor Andre Guettler argues a material share of reported perpetual futures volume on the platforms may be manufactured, which would overstate the demand behind their valuations. Polymarket revenue and analytics head Kyle Gesuelli told CNBC the activity in its low-odds contracts comes from highly active sharp traders correcting mispricing, not wash trading. ([BusinessCircle](https://businesscircle.co/2026/09/30/kalshi-polymarket-trading-volumes-on-some-products-raises-questions-amid-massive-growth/))

items.title: Prediction market weekend volume tops 10 billion dollars as Polymarket US grows 13 percent
items.content_text: - **Prediction market weekend volume tops 10 billion dollars as Polymarket US grows 13 percent** — TickerTracker recorded more than 10.4 billion dollars in notional volume across tracked prediction market platforms over the weekend, an 11 percent increase from the previous weekend. Polymarket US generated about 1.18 billion dollars, up 13.2 percent, followed by DkEx at 391 million dollars, Novig at 332 million dollars, Crypto.com CDNA at 316 million dollars and Underdog at 196 million dollars. items.title: Bitquery finds 321 large wallets drove 53 percent of Polymarket midterm volume
items.content_text: - **Bitquery finds 321 large wallets drove 53 percent of Polymarket midterm volume** — Bitquery analysis of Polymarket midterm markets found 103.4 million dollars traded since September 2025, with 53 percent of the money coming from 321 wallets that each traded 100,000 dollars or more. One account holds about 1.03 million dollars net on the Republican side across the Senate map and would collect 1.78 million dollars if every position wins. ([Bitquery](https://bitquery.io/investigations/polymarket-midterms-odds-2026))

items.title: Robinhood builds its own prediction market venture as partner-fed model faces competition
items.content_text: - **Robinhood builds its own prediction market venture as partner-fed model faces competition** — Robinhood is building its own event contracts venture, expected to begin operations in 2026 subject to regulatory approvals, while it continues its current arrangement in the meantime. The company has been updating its prediction markets hub to look more like a traditional sportsbook and rolled out 24/7 trading for event contracts, as FanDuel, DraftKings and Crypto.com expand rival offerings. items.title: Polymarket archives nuclear detonation contract amid backlash over war and death markets
items.content_text: - **Polymarket archives nuclear detonation contract amid backlash over war and death markets** — Polymarket archived its nuclear weapon detonation market after public criticism, with a cached page showing more than 650,000 dollars in volume before removal. Bubblemaps flagged wallets earning about 1 million dollars betting on U.S. strikes on Iran ahead of the attacks, while Kalshi invoked a death carveout and senators urged the CFTC to ban death contracts. ([Crypto Economy](https://crypto-economy.com/polymarket-shuts-down-nuclear-event-contract/))

items.title: Explainer maps how prediction markets are regulated by the CFTC and the states
items.content_text: - **Explainer maps how prediction markets are regulated by the CFTC and the states** — A regulation explainer notes prediction markets operate federally under the CFTC, which treats event contracts as derivatives and supervises the exchanges listing them. Many states view the same products, especially sports contracts, as gambling, so access and rules vary by location. ([Investopedia](https://www.investopedia.com/how-are-prediction-markets-regulated-12142137))

items.title: CFTC moves to rewrite swap rules to cover prediction market event contracts
items.content_text: - **CFTC moves to rewrite swap rules to cover prediction market event contracts** — The CFTC has proposed rules that would codify sports, political, cultural and weather event contracts as federally regulated swaps, while carving conventional casino-style gambling products out of that definition. The agency says the change would clarify that event contracts fall within its exclusive jurisdiction under the Commodity Exchange Act. ([CoinSpectator](https://coinspectator.com/mainstream/2026/10/10/why-the-cftc-is-rewriting-swap-rules-for-prediction-markets-and-how-it-shifts-the-balance-of-power/))

items.title: CME Group launches first baseball futures tied to team performance indexes
items.content_text: - **CME Group launches first baseball futures tied to team performance indexes** — CME Group launched the first baseball futures on October 12, pending regulatory review, with contracts tracking its FutureSports Performance Indexes for all 30 MLB teams. Trading begins with the four League Championship Series clubs, in standard contracts valued at 10 times the index and micro contracts at one tenth that size. ([Morningstar](https://www.morningstar.com/news/pr-newswire/20261008cg67431/cme-group-to-launch-worlds-first-baseball-futures-on-october-12))

items.title: Polymarket bank-failure bets draw UK scrutiny over market integrity risks
items.content_text: - **Polymarket bank-failure bets draw UK scrutiny over market integrity risks** — Bets on Polymarket's offshore platform on whether major global banks will fail have drawn scrutiny in the United Kingdom, where the Financial Conduct Authority has said the financial prediction products it examined function similarly to binary options, banned for British retail consumers since 2019. The FCA is discussing prediction markets with overseas regulators and the Bank of England is also monitoring developments. items.title: Robinhood prediction markets generate 156 million dollars in second-quarter revenue, passing crypto
items.content_text: - **Robinhood prediction markets generate 156 million dollars in second-quarter revenue, passing crypto** — Robinhood's event contracts generated about 156 million dollars of revenue in the quarter ended June 30, more than ten times the year-earlier figure and ahead of crypto transaction revenue of about 100 million dollars. Customers traded a record 13.6 billion event contracts in the quarter, making prediction markets the company's second-largest source of transaction-based revenue behind options. items.content_text: - **Tribal operators back Kalshi as FanDuel retreats from CME event contracts** — Four tribal gaming operators have signed distribution partnerships with Kalshi, breaking from the traditional casino lobby, while FanDuel continued distancing itself from CME-linked event contracts, according to SBC Americas reporting. items.title: CFTC proposes classifying prediction market event contracts as swaps while excluding sportsbook wagers
items.content_text: - **CFTC proposes classifying prediction market event contracts as swaps while excluding sportsbook wagers** — The CFTC has proposed a rule defining event contracts on sports, politics, culture and weather as swaps under the Commodity Exchange Act, paired with an interim rule excluding casino games and traditional sportsbook wagers from that definition. Both actions are subject to a 30-day public comment period. ([Virlan](https://www.virlan.co/igaming/cftc-proposes-rules-classifying-prediction-market-event-contracts-as-swaps-while-excluding-sportsbooks/))

items.title: NFL tells Supreme Court sports prediction contracts are gambling, not swaps
items.content_text: - **NFL tells Supreme Court sports prediction contracts are gambling, not swaps** — The NFL filed an amicus brief urging the Supreme Court to hear New Jersey's case against Kalshi, arguing that sports contracts on prediction markets are gambling rather than CFTC-regulated swaps. The league cited game integrity and consumer protection concerns, including trading tied to NFL games. ([The Block](https://www.theblock.co/news/regulation/2026-10-08-nfl-amicus-brief-supreme-court-kalshi-new-jersey-prediction-markets-418064))

items.title: Kalshi and Polymarket prepare perpetual futures markets for U.S. traders
items.content_text: - **Kalshi and Polymarket prepare perpetual futures markets for U.S. traders** — Kalshi and Polymarket are preparing perpetual futures products that would let U.S. traders hold leveraged positions without a fixed settlement date, with sample interfaces showing crypto, metals and stock contracts at up to 10 times leverage. The launch follows CFTC approval for Kalshi affiliate Kinetic Markets to offer margin trading as a futures commission merchant. items.title: Kalshi files to end volume reward program as Ether trade scrutiny grows
items.content_text: - **Kalshi files to end volume reward program as Ether trade scrutiny grows** — Kalshi filed with the CFTC to end its Volume Incentive Program no earlier than October 13, after September trading volume reached 52.98 billion dollars through September 29. Reports say the CFTC is reviewing more than 5 billion dollars in repeated Ether perpetual futures trades, which Kalshi says came from market makers and fast traders hitting quotes. items.title: Kalshi asks full Sixth Circuit to review panel decision favoring Ohio and Tennessee officials
items.content_text: - **Kalshi asks full Sixth Circuit to review panel decision favoring Ohio and Tennessee officials** — Kalshi filed a request on October 13 for the full Sixth Circuit to rehear its Ohio and Tennessee cases, arguing the panel misinterpreted the Commodity Exchange Act on two points. The panel had let both states apply gambling laws to Kalshi sports contracts, and Kalshi is reserving a possible Supreme Court appeal. items.title: Ohio leads 39-state coalition urging Supreme Court review of prediction market case
items.content_text: - **Ohio leads 39-state coalition urging Supreme Court review of prediction market case** — Ohio Attorney General D. Andrew Wilson led 39 states and the District of Columbia in an October 7 amicus brief asking the Supreme Court to decide whether state gambling laws apply to sports event contracts on federally regulated platforms. The brief cites the split between the Third and Sixth Circuits over federal preemption. ([iGaming Post](https://igamingpost.com/ohio-leads-39-state-coalition-urging-supreme-court-review-of-prediction-market-case/))

items.content_text: - **CFTC moves to classify prediction market event contracts as swaps amid state pushback** — The CFTC issued an interim final rule and proposed a new rule to classify event contracts as swaps under its jurisdiction, covering sports, politics, culture and weather. The company also said self-clearing membership is open to firms meeting CFTC requirements and that it offers no rebates on crypto event contracts. items.title: Kalshi fee structure turns even-money prices into minus 107 for takers, analysis shows
items.content_text: - **Kalshi fee structure turns even-money prices into minus 107 for takers, analysis shows** — An analysis of Kalshi pricing explains that a 50 cent contract shown as even money costs minus 107 when taking the price and minus 102 when the order waits. Long-shot prices are affected most, with a plus 900 screen price returning plus 841 after fees. ([BettingPros](https://www.bettingpros.com/articles/how-kalshi-sports-betting-works/))

items.title: Kalshi ends its volume rewards program effective October 13
items.content_text: - **Kalshi ends its volume rewards program effective October 13** — KalshiEX notified the CFTC on September 28 that it is terminating its Volume Incentive Program effective no earlier than October 13, replacing a previous end date in 2027. The program had awarded eligible participants a share of per-market rewards based on qualifying trading volume, and no replacement was announced in the filing. ([Crypto Economy](https://crypto-economy.com/kalshi-ends-volume-rewards-program/))

items.title: Cboe and Robinhood plan October launch of KPI binary contracts for 23 companies
items.content_text: - **Cboe and Robinhood plan October launch of KPI binary contracts for 23 companies** — Cboe and Robinhood announced on September 30 a planned launch of binary contracts tied to company-specific key performance indicators for 23 U.S.-listed companies, expected to roll out in October subject to regulatory approval. items.content_text: - **DraftKings builds its own prediction exchange while FanDuel leans on partners, comparison finds** — DraftKings launched its own exchange, DKeX, in June using technology and a CFTC license gained from buying Railbird Technologies, while FanDuel kept CME Group for financial contracts and moved sports and novelty contracts to Crypto.com. items.title: CFTC rule draws line between gambling and prediction market contracts
items.content_text: - **CFTC rule draws line between gambling and prediction market contracts** — The CFTC issued an interim final rule on October 9 that excludes traditional sports wagers and casino games from the definition of a swap. A separate proposed rule would classify event contracts tied to sports, politics, culture and weather as swaps under CFTC oversight, with a 30-day comment period after Federal Register publication. ([TokenPost](https://www.tokenpost.com/news/regulation/29261))
